messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up 1 Daniela Cruz submitted her resignation today; last day set for 2025-06-06 (Fri). Need coordinated offboard: COBRA packet, final pay + accrued PTO payout, visa sponsorship note (if any), device return/shipping options, SSO and badge deactivation, and a short exit interview. Assigning owners: @Hannah @Chris @Raj @Sophie.
Daniela Cruz: Thanks everyone. I'll leave a runbook for my onboardings and can ship the laptop or drop at the SF office before EOD on the 6th.
Chris (IT): I'll arrange a prepaid label if shipping. Proposed deprovision on 2025-06-06: freeze admin at 16:30 PT, revoke cloud keys at 17:00 PT, disable SSO at 17:15 PT. I'll post the label once booked.
Hannah (Payroll): Benefits end on last active day (2025-06-06). COBRA email is automatic; I'll also trigger manual packet for international mailing by 2025-06-13. Please submit any outstanding expenses by 2025-06-04 EOD to make final payroll. Daniela, we'll include accrued PTO per CA policy on final pay.
Raj (Security): Badge access disabled 2025-06-06 17:30 PT. Facilities can accept drop-off or hold package for one week. If Daniela ships, please share tracking to this thread.
Sophie (Legal): Quick check: Daniela is not on sponsored visa, correct? If she is, we need to send notice to counsel within 7 business days. Otherwise standard separation letter will be sent.
Daniela Cruz: Correct, I'm on standard work authorization. I've uploaded my outstanding expense (~$85) and confirmed shipping preference: I'll ship with the prepaid label.
Maya (People Ops): Exit interview options: 06/05 15:00 PT (30m) or 06/06 09:00 PT (15m). Daniela, which do you prefer?
Daniela Cruz: 06/05 15:00 PT works.
Maya (People Ops): Recap owners & deadlines: Hannah 1 COBRA packet + final payroll confirmation (by 2025-06-13). Chris 1 ship label + key revokes (label by 2025-06-07, revokes on 2025-06-06). Raj 1 badge disable & facilities hold (2025-06-06). Sophie 1 separation letter (by 2025-06-04). Daniela 1 submit expenses and ship device (by 2025-06-04/06). I'll run the exit interview on 06/05 and mark checklist complete after final pay confirmed. :thumbsup:
Chris (IT): :thumbsup: I'll post tracking once booked.
Hannah (Payroll): :ok_hand: I'll confirm PTO payout schedule after payroll run closes.
Daniela Cruz: Thanks all 1 appreciate the quick coordination.
